name: Order Confirmation
description: Confirm a customer's order with summary details.
html_content:
Your order is confirmed

Hi {first_name},

Thanks for your order — we're getting it ready now.

Order summary

  • Order #: {order_number}
  • Total: {order_total}
  • Estimated delivery: {estimated_delivery}

You'll get another email as soon as it ships, with tracking details.

If anything looks wrong, reply to this email and we'll fix it right away.

— The {company_name} Team
